title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the discrepancy case be presented?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance review tutor will present a discrepancy case on Thursday at ten. Students should bring the component record and the inspection extract. The case includes a difference between the recorded part reference and the label on the training item. Students will identify the information that must be checked before the record is corrected.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which records are required for the discrepancy case?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance review tutor will present a discrepancy case on Thursday at ten. Students should bring the component record and the inspection extract. The case includes a difference between the recorded part reference and the label on the training item. Students will identify the information that must be checked before the record is corrected.
options: The component record and inspection extract

tasks.prompt: A review found that the part reference in a component record did not match the label on the training item. The reviewer compared the delivery record, inspection entry and current parts information. The difference could not be resolved from the available copy, so the reviewer recorded the discrepancy and requested confirmation from the responsible stores team. The record was not changed until the correct reference had been verified. Reading 1. Which records did the reviewer compare?
options: Delivery record, inspection entry and current parts information

tasks.prompt: Why was the record not changed immediately?
options: The correct reference had to be verified first

tasks.prompt: The record ___ until the correct reference has been verified.
Choose TWO actions that support a controlled discrepancy review.
options: Change the reference based on appearance
Request confirmation from the responsible team

tasks.prompt: A change made to correct an error in a record is an ___.
A part reference differs between two records. What should you write?
options: The label is probably wrong; I have changed the record.
The references do not match; could the responsible team confirm the correct part number before amendment?
I will choose the number that looks familiar.
The mismatch does not need to be recorded.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of maintenance discrepancy analysis in a logical order.
options: Request confirmation where evidence is incomplete
Update the record through the approved process
correctOrder: Request confirmation where evidence is incomplete
Update the record through the approved process

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words summarising how to investigate a discrepancy between a component label and its record. Include evidence, confirmation and controlled correction.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); precise technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
